name: Iterable
description_en:
Iterable is a customer-engagement platform for coordinating communication across email, mobile and other channels. For an operations team, Studio journeys are the practical center of evaluation: a user enters from a defined source, passes through messages, filters, waits or integrations, and eventually exits.

The implementation details matter more than a generic omnichannel label. Iterable distinguishes event admission from scheduled list admission, real-action tests from a sandbox, and journey exit from cancellation of an already optimized send. A useful pilot should make those distinctions observable with controlled identities and event payloads before a larger audience is admitted.
description_zh:
Iterable 是协调邮件、移动端及其他渠道沟通的客户互动平台。对运营团队而言，Studio 旅程是实际评估中心：用户从明确来源加入，经过消息、筛选、等待或集成步骤，最终退出。

实施细节比泛化的全渠道标签更重要。Iterable 区分事件加入与定时列表加入、真实动作测试与沙盒，以及旅程退出与取消已优化排期的发送。有效试点应先使用受控身份和事件载荷观察这些差异，再加入更大受众。

core_features.explanation_en: Start tiles define eligibility, repetition and concurrent participation.
core_features.explanation_zh: Start 模块定义资格、重复及并发参与。

core_features.explanation_en: Hold Until can branch on a later event or property change.
core_features.explanation_zh: Hold Until 可按后续事件或属性变化分支。

core_features.explanation_en: Journey webhooks connect a tile to an external endpoint.
core_features.explanation_zh: 旅程 webhook 将模块连接到外部端点。

core_features.explanation_en: Optional journey events record eligible exits and their paths.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可选旅程事件记录符合条件的退出及路径。

en: Editorial fit: a lifecycle team with reliable event instrumentation and multiple messaging channels.
Editorial fit: an operations team that can validate identity, message eligibility and integration failure behavior.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：具有可靠事件采集及多个消息渠道的生命周期团队。
编辑判断的适用场景：能够验证身份、消息资格与集成失败行为的运营团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose a single admission source and test an import separately from a new event.
steps.zh: 选择单一加入来源，分别测试导入与新事件。

steps.en: Use an internal email identity and explicitly select test actions.
steps.zh: 使用内部邮箱身份，明确选择测试动作。

steps.en: Trace optimized sends and webhook outcomes alongside exits.
steps.zh: 对照退出追踪优化发送及 webhook 结果。

steps.en: Check campaign-level suppression and recording capacity before broadening the cohort.
steps.zh: 扩大群体前检查活动级抑制与记录容量。

items.en: The same marketing campaign is limited to one send per recipient in 18 hours; repeated tests may be suppressed.
items.zh: 同一营销活动每位收件人 18 小时内限发一次，重复测试可能被抑制。

items.en: A live journey can still fail to send when its message campaign is inactive or archived; inspect the referenced campaign.
items.zh: 消息活动未启用或已归档时，运行中的旅程仍可能不发信，需检查关联活动。

items.en: Configured entry and exit logic does not establish end-to-end latency or a delivery guarantee.
items.zh: 已配置入口与退出逻辑不能确认端到端延迟或投递保证。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The official sales page offers a pricing estimate, integration information and a demo. The attempted /pricing URL redirected to the homepage; no public dollar amount or ongoing free plan was established. Confirm channel volumes, custom-event and journey-event allowances, services and contract scope in the actual quote. No normalized price assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 官方销售页提供价格估算、集成信息及演示。尝试访问 /pricing 后跳回首页，未确认公开金额或长期免费套餐。应在实际报价中确认渠道量、自定义事件及旅程事件额度、服务与合同范围。不生成标准化价格。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Importing a list does not automatically replay subscriptions
sections.title_zh: 导入列表不等于自动重放订阅
sections.en: The admission guide offers event, schedule, API and Other Journey sources, with one source selected per Start tile. A CSV import needs its Trigger journey entries and exits setting enabled to participate in linked automation. As an editorial onboarding example, separate existing subscribers from genuinely new subscriptions, then decide whether a scheduled audience or a subscription event matches the intended timing. For multiple sources, the documented pattern connects source journeys to a main journey; it is not multiple independent Start selections on one canvas.
sections.zh: 加入指南提供事件、定时、API 和 Other Journey 来源，每个 Start 选择一个来源。CSV 导入需要开启 Trigger journey entries and exits 才能参与关联自动化。编辑示例：入门流程应先区分已有订阅者与新订阅，再判断定时受众还是订阅事件符合预期时机。多来源的文档方案是将来源旅程连接到主旅程，并非同一画布选择多个独立 Start。

sections.title_en: An update trigger need not mean a changed value
sections.title_zh: 更新入口不一定意味着值已变化
sections.en: User Profile Update admission can fire when the specified field is included in an update call even if its value is unchanged. Maximum entries defaults to unlimited, while simultaneous participation defaults to finishing before re-entry. Changes to entry limits are prospective, and changing an email in an email-based project resets that identity’s limit. Test repeated identical updates and identity changes explicitly; do not rely on a renamed once-only policy to deduplicate historical activity.
sections.zh: User Profile Update 加入可因更新调用包含指定字段而触发，即使字段值未变化。最大加入次数默认无限，同时参与默认需先完成再重入。加入限制的修改面向后续用户，按邮箱识别的项目中修改邮箱还会重置该身份的限制。应明确测试相同值重复更新与身份变化，不能依赖后来改成仅一次的规则去重历史活动。

sections.title_en: The test runner can send real messages
sections.title_zh: 测试器可能发送真实消息
sections.en: Journey tests can execute messages, webhooks and profile or subscription changes even while a journey is off, and resulting engagement affects metrics. The runner has action toggles and normally shortens delay/hold durations. It requires an email address rather than only userId; sample event input takes the dataFields contents, not a complete tracking payload. Evaluate an internal profile, deliberately choose enabled actions and timing, then inspect the inbox and event history. This is a suggested test design; none was run here.
sections.zh: 即使旅程关闭，旅程测试仍可执行消息、webhook、档案或订阅修改，产生的互动会影响指标。测试器提供动作开关，且通常会缩短延迟／等待时间。它要求邮箱，不能只提供 userId；样例事件输入应为 dataFields 内容，而非完整跟踪载荷。评估时应选内部档案，明确开启哪些动作及计时，再检查收件箱与事件历史。本次仅提出测试方案，未运行。

sections.title_en: A waiting tile has its own observation window
sections.title_zh: 等待模块有自己的观察窗口
sections.en: Hold Until looks for events or property changes after a user enters that tile and is capped at 30 days. A journey-wide exit rule is a different check. Existing Time Delay occupants retain their original delay after an edit. For an editorial purchase-follow-up pilot, emit one purchase before the hold and another after entry, then check both branches and timeout behavior. Do not assume the earlier purchase will release the hold, or that shortening a live delay accelerates people already waiting.
sections.zh: Hold Until 观察用户进入该模块之后的事件或属性变化，上限为 30 天。旅程级退出规则是不同的检查。Time Delay 修改后，已在其中的用户仍保留原延迟。编辑示例：购买跟进试点可分别在等待前、加入后发送一次购买事件，检查两个分支与超时行为。不能假设较早购买会释放等待，也不能假设缩短运行中延迟会加速已等待用户。

sections.title_en: Exiting a journey is not guaranteed send recall
sections.title_zh: 退出旅程不能保证撤回发送
sections.en: Exit rules generally remove a user at the end of the current tile; Time Delay has a documented exception of within 48 hours or before the next tile, whichever is earlier. The guide specifically says a message scheduled by Send Time Decisioning still sends at its chosen time even if the user has exited. An evaluation should therefore trace the message’s scheduling state as well as the exit event. A purchase suppression requirement needs verification against this behavior before it becomes a customer promise.
sections.zh: 退出规则通常在当前模块结束时移除用户；Time Delay 有例外：事件后 48 小时内或进入下一模块前，取较早者。指南特别说明，即使用户已退出，由 Send Time Decisioning 排期的消息仍会在选定时间发送。因此评估应同时追踪消息排期状态与退出事件。购买后停止促销的要求，必须先对照此行为验证，再向客户承诺。

sections.title_en: Turning off and stopping new admission have different effects
sections.title_zh: 关闭旅程与停止新加入的效果不同
sections.en: Turning a journey off removes existing users after their current step; disconnecting Start is the documented way to block new admission while keeping existing users moving. The exit guide also says a user still in Time Delay can continue if the journey is re-enabled before that delay finishes. The FAQ warns long-delay users may exit sooner, so off/on is not a documented freeze-and-resume guarantee. Inspect actual occupants before an operational change.
sections.zh: 关闭旅程会在现有用户完成当前步骤后移除他们；文档建议断开 Start 来阻止新加入，同时保留现有用户继续执行。退出指南还说，若在用户的 Time Delay 结束前重新开启，其可继续前进。FAQ 又提醒长延迟用户可能提前退出，因此关闭／开启不能视为有保证的冻结恢复。操作前应检查实际在途用户。

sections.title_en: A retryable endpoint must tolerate duplicate calls
sections.title_zh: 可重试端点必须容忍重复调用
sections.en: Journey webhooks time out after 10 seconds. Timeouts and 429/502/503/504 responses receive up to three retries at three-minute intervals; persistent failure exits the user. Delivery order and uniqueness are not guaranteed. Webhook tiles discard responses, while Live Data tiles expose captured data downstream. In a controlled integration evaluation, record an idempotency key and exercise success, timeout and terminal error responses. These rules belong to journey webhooks and should not be copied to system-webhook assumptions.
sections.zh: 旅程 webhook 在十秒后超时；超时及 429／502／503／504 响应会以三分钟间隔最多重试三次，持续失败会使用户退出。投递顺序及唯一性无保证。Webhook 模块丢弃响应，Live Data 模块则将捕获数据供后续使用。受控集成评估应记录幂等键，并覆盖成功、超时及终止错误响应。这些规则属于旅程 webhook，不能套用到系统 webhook。

sections.title_en: Journey history can stop recording while journeys remain configured
sections.title_zh: 旅程已配置不代表历史持续记录
sections.en: Exit-event tracking is enabled per journey, retains 90 days and has a default organization-wide allowance of two million events monthly unless the contract differs. Enabling it does not backfill history. At the limit, tracking is disabled across journeys and must be enabled again individually after reset or additional capacity. Distinguish a missing recorded event from a missing user action. Separately, conversion tracking begins when its goal is added; older conversions are not recovered automatically.
sections.zh: 退出事件跟踪需逐旅程开启，保留 90 天；合同无另行约定时，组织级默认每月额度为 200 万事件。开启后不补录历史。达到上限会停用各旅程跟踪，额度重置或增加后仍需分别重新开启。应区分记录缺失与用户未行动。另行设置的转化目标也从添加时开始跟踪，不会自动恢复此前转化。

seo.title_en: Iterable: journey entry, testing, exit and webhook behavior
seo.title_zh: Iterable：旅程加入、测试、退出与 webhook 行为
seo.description_en: Evaluate Iterable Studio admission rules, real-action testing, optimized-send exit limits, webhook retries and journey-event capacity.
seo.description_zh: 评估 Iterable Studio 加入规则、真实动作测试、优化发送退出边界、webhook 重试及旅程事件容量。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Iterable lifecycle journey operations and implementation limits
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: No account operations, messages, event ingestion, webhook calls or sales inquiry were performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户操作、发送消息、采集事件、调用 webhook 或咨询销售。

research_gaps.en: Current quote, contract-specific channel eligibility, UI languages, regions and self-hosting rights remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 当前报价、合同特定渠道资格、界面语言、地区及自托管权利仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: Off/on timing, message recall boundaries and live-version behavior were not tested; documentation is not a runtime guarantee.
research_gaps.zh: 未实测关闭／开启计时、消息撤回边界及运行版本行为；文档不构成运行保证。
